market_outlook.short_term: Bullish but volatile. AI-driven tech rally continues but Hormuz oil risk and Fed hike fears create whipsaw. S&P 500 likely tests new highs on Meta/AMD momentum. Crypto and EM benefit from risk-on. Watch for bond yield spikes that could trigger sharp corrections.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (data centers > housing) supports 2-3 year structural growth. However, recession risk, political polarization, and AI concentration create tail risks. US-China trade normalization is a positive structural shift. German industrial decline and tariff spillovers are headwinds.
